Desktop OSes haven’t fundamentally evolved in 20 years!

Scott Jenson explores why, and what comes next:
→ Moving beyond ecosystem lock-in
→ Reimagining interface design
→ Building specialized ""Local-First"" software
→ Creating intuitive, privacy-conscious UX for the ""LLM everywhere"" era
